title: Kaluga region introduces odd-even gasoline rationing
detail: Kaluga region introduced a fuel rationing system based on vehicle registration numbers starting Aug 15, becoming at least the sixth Russian region to reinstate or tighten fuel-sale restrictions since Aug 10 after authorities reported renewed queues at filling stations — a sign the second wave of the fuel crisis was spreading toward Moscow.

media.caption: Kaluga and other regions reinstate fuel rationing amid second shortage wave
